amphora-barrier-corrosion-score: Directional barrier/corrosion rank, never hard authority.
amphora-candidate-contract: Shared JSON contract for MVP20 split scoring services.
amphora-cro-protocol-packager: Build CRO-ready candidate packets and capture templates.
amphora-cure-potlife-gate: This module now owns two deliberately separate tracks:
amphora-design-rule-score: Rule-cited formulation scoring without performance overclaim.
amphora-envelope-gates: Hard/soft gate evaluation against the v5 envelope.
amphora-formulation-arithmetic: Deterministic BOM arithmetic and solvent simultaneity solve.
amphora-formulation-universe: Enumerate formulation candidates onto the target surface.
amphora-ingredient-library: Build ingredient/property libraries from cited facts only.
amphora-ip-fto-guard: Technical IP/FTO guardrail, not legal advice.
amphora-model-card-authority: Central authority registry for model rank rights.
amphora-molecule-design-gate: Conservative structural applicability gate for explicitly declared resin and hardener molecules. Resins require an authorized epoxide; hardeners require a non-aromatic, non-amide active amine N-H. The gate makes no toxicity, EHS, procurement, synthesis, qualification, or product-performance prediction.
amphora-molecule-generator: Generate or normalize molecule proposals for upstream AI/evolution.
amphora-molecule-novelty: Computes deterministic Morgan-radius-2/Tanimoto distance from the cached feedback-v1 polymer corpus. `novelty_score = 1 - max_similarity` is an R&D design-space objective only. It does not predict coating performance, synthesis feasibility, toxicity, qualification, or procurement.
amphora-molecule-property: Score exact EEW/AHEW and a non-authoritative density estimate from defined, single-component structures. The versioned benchmark is `reference/mvp20/data/eew_ahew_benchmark.v1.json`; commercial polydisperse products remain measured-only.
amphora-molecule-role-ranker: Score a defined molecule against both resin and hardener role tracks for the epoxy-polyamide marine-primer envelope. Exact EEW/AHEW and structure validity come exclusively from `amphora-molecule-property`; commercial and polydisperse products remain measured-only.
amphora-optimizer-orchestrator: Evolution/AI multi-objective engine that consumes ScoreEnvelopes.
amphora-process-qc-twin: Fail-closed process/QC/SPC evidence service. It can flag an evidence package, but it never authorizes batch release.
amphora-public-corrosion-benchmark: Rights-bound public corrosion/EIS benchmark ingestion and locked evaluation.
amphora-redteam-audit: System-level claim discipline and v5 score caps.
amphora-report-packager: Human deliverables only, downstream of scores.
amphora-source-ledger: Anti-fabrication citation ledger for physical constants and source records.
